title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Daniel Levine-Spound (@dlspound) is a human rights lawyer and researcher. He currently teaches at the Harvard Law School International Human Rights Clinic (IHRC), where he manages projects related to international humanitarian law, international human rights law, and the protection of civilians (POC) in armed conflict. Prior to joining IHRC, Daniel was a Fellow at the […]
